strategy.summary: Plunge through Spot All Targets to start Diamond Hurry-Up. Knock down six diamond drop targets to score it and start another. When the right orbit lights, lock a ball; the hurry-up timer keeps running. Plunge to start Multiball and continue the target loop with two balls.

quickInfo.name: Diamond Hurry-Up
quickInfo.summary: Spot All Targets or a full drop-target completion starts it. Knock down the six diamond drop targets to collect it and immediately begin another cycle.

quickInfo.name: Spot All Targets skill plunge
quickInfo.summary: Plunge across the lane rollover when the bottom of its three inserts is lit to start the first Diamond Hurry-Up.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Completing all six diamond targets lights the right orbit to lock a ball; the game then feeds the shooter lane for Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Playfield X
quickInfo.summary: Each lit top lane during Multiball adds 1x, up to 15x. It does not multiply Diamond Hurry-Up, Royal Flush, or All Diamonds Down.

quickInfo.name: Royal Flush
quickInfo.summary: Completing A-K-Q-J-10 resets all drops and ends the active Diamond Hurry-Up loop.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: An inlane briefly lights its spinner. Use the incoming ball to shoot that spinner before the timer ends.

steps.text: Plunge across the skill lane while Spot All Targets is lit to start Diamond Hurry-Up.
Knock down all six diamond drop targets before the hurry-up ends.
Repeat the six diamond targets when the next Diamond Hurry-Up begins.
When the right orbit lights, shoot it to lock a ball. Diamond Hurry-Up continues to count down.
Plunge the served ball to start Multiball. Use the second ball to finish the active six-target cycle.
During Multiball, roll through lit top lanes to raise Playfield X, then return to the diamond-target loop.
When an inlane lights its spinner, shoot that spinner before the short timer ends.
Avoid completing Royal Flush while the Diamond Hurry-Up loop is paying well.

buildsToward.title: Run Diamond Hurry-Up during multiplied Multiball

steps.text: Start Diamond Hurry-Up with Spot All Targets or a full target completion.
Complete six diamond targets to light the right-orbit lock and restart the hurry-up.
Shoot the lit right orbit to lock a ball. Diamond Hurry-Up continues to count down.
Plunge the served ball to start Multiball.
Use lit top lanes to raise Playfield X while continuing the diamond-target cycle.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Diamond Lady from 1988 and read Competition Mode, Extra Ball, Special, and Royal Flush awards.
Test the six drop-target rebounds, right-orbit lock feed, top lanes, kickback timer, and both timed spinners.
strategy.simpleOverview: Diamond Lady turns repeated six-target completions into a continuous Diamond Hurry-Up loop. The same targets light a right-orbit lock, Multiball adds Playfield X through the top lanes, and completing Royal Flush ends the active hurry-up cycle.
strategy.overview: Completing all six diamond drop targets in Diamond Lady collects and restarts Diamond Hurry-Up and lights the right-orbit lock. Lock one ball there, plunge to start Multiball, and continue the target cycle while lit top lanes raise Playfield X. Avoid Royal Flush while the Hurry-Up loop is valuable because it resets the drops and ends that cycle.
